instructions:
1. Lie on your back with legs straight and together, arms extended overhead holding an ab roller.
2. Brace your core and lift your straight legs toward the ceiling.
3. At the same time, raise the ab roller toward your toes, curling your upper back off the floor.
4. Slowly lower your legs and the roller back down, stopping just before they touch the floor.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and under control rather than swinging your legs.
2. Keep your lower back from arching as you lower the legs.
3. Reduce the range of motion if you cannot keep your core braced.
4. Exhale as you lift toward your toes.
name: Wheels To Toes

instructions:
1. Load one end of a barbell into a landmine and kneel on both knees facing it.
2. Hold the bar end at shoulder height with one hand, elbow tucked.
3. Brace your core and press the bar up and forward until the arm is extended.
4. Lower the bar back to your shoulder under control.
5. Repeat with the other arm, alternating each rep.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips and torso square; do not let the load twist you.
2. Squeeze your glutes to stay tall through each press.
3. Drive the bar slightly forward, not straight up.
4. Exhale as you press.
name: Landmine Kneeling Alternating Overhead Press

instructions:
1. Load one end of a barbell into a landmine and kneel on both knees facing it.
2. Hold the bar end at shoulder height with both hands, elbows tucked.
3. Brace your core and press the bar up and forward until your arms are extended.
4. Lower the bar back to your shoulders under control.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso upright and core braced throughout.
2. Squeeze your glutes to stay stable on your knees.
3. Press the bar along its natural arc, slightly forward.
4. Exhale as you press.
name: Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press

instructions:
1. Load one end of a barbell into a landmine and kneel on both knees facing it.
2. Hold the bar end with both hands, arms extended in front of your chest.
3. Brace your core and rotate the bar down and across toward one hip.
4. Control the bar back to center, then rotate to the other side.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the rotation from your core, not your arms.
2. Keep your hips facing forward as the torso turns.
3. Move smoothly and avoid jerking at the end range.
4. Exhale as you twist.
name: Landmine Kneeling Twist

instructions:
1. Load one end of a barbell into a landmine and hold the bar end at your chest.
2. Stand tall with feet together, facing the landmine.
3. Step out to one side and bend that knee, pushing your hips back while keeping the other leg straight.
4. Lower until your bent thigh is near parallel, keeping your chest up.
5. Drive through the bent leg to return to standing.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the foot of the working leg flat and toes forward.
2. Push your hips back rather than letting the knee cave in.
3. Keep your chest tall and core braced.
4. Feel a stretch in the inner thigh of the straight leg.
name: Landmine Lateral Lunge
